ai_language_tip: Speak clear, polite standard Polish (pl); English works in Warsaw, Kraków, Wrocław, Gdańsk and at hotels and younger staff, much less at public clinics (NFZ), offices and small-town trades.
english_ok: sometimes — Common in big-city centres, hotels and among under-40 staff; scarce at NFZ clinics, municipal offices, garages and rural guesthouses.
politeness: Use formal Pan/Pani with third-person verbs, never 'ty' with strangers; open with 'Dzień dobry' and say on whose behalf you call; close with 'Dziękuję, do widzenia'.
name_tip: Give surname first ('na nazwisko Kowalski'); Polish surnames change by gender (Kowalski/Kowalska), so state the exact form; spell foreign names letter by letter.
phone_tip: Mobile and landline are both 9 digits with no leading 0 (mobile 123 456 789, Warsaw landline 22 123 45 67); +48 country code; SMS confirmation is normal.
time_tip: TRAP: 'wpół do ósmej' = 7:30 (half before eight), like German 'halb acht'; 'za kwadrans ósma' = 7:45; always read back in 24h ('dziewiętnasta trzydzieści').
number_tip: Numbers to people use special forms ('dwie osoby', 'troje dzieci', 'pięć osób'); read phone numbers in groups of three (123 456 789).
avoid_calling: Avoid restaurant peaks around 13:00–15:00 (obiad) and 18:30–20:30, calls after 20:00, and Sundays for shops (Sunday trading ban); public clinics answer best right after opening at 7:00–8:00.
closed_days: Sunday trading ban for most shops (only a few trading Sundays a year); public holidays such as Easter Monday, 1 and 3 May, Corpus Christi, 15 August, 1 and 11 November, 24 December (since 2025) and 25–26 December close most businesses.
booking_channels: ZnanyLekarz (Docplanner) for doctors and dentists, IKP/NFZ e-rejestracja at some public clinics; Booksy for salons and barbers; MojStolik/E-stolik and Google for tables but phone and Facebook/Instagram messages still dominant; Pyszne.pl, Glovo, Wolt, Uber Eats for delivery.
voice_menu: Mobile operators (Orange, Play, Plus, T-Mobile), banks, PKP, InPost and NFZ hotlines use keypad IVR; larger private clinic chains (Lux Med, Medicover) route through call centres.
callback_habits: Booksy and ZnanyLekarz send SMS reminders; small businesses confirm by SMS or call back from a mobile; clinics often call or SMS a day before.

activity.before_dialing_zh: 保齡球、密室（escape room）、滑雪學校與導覽可電話訂；鹽礦與熱門博物館多需官網預購時段票。

may_come_up.what: Wieliczka-style mine tours sold in timed slots online

sensitive_asked.what: Prepayment to a private konto for a group

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 波蘭髮廊、美甲、理髮店普遍用 Booksy，但多數也接電話預約；hybrydy 美甲很常見。

may_come_up.what: Booksy no-show rule or zadatek for long colour

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期取消宜提早；Booksy、ZnanyLekarz 預約可在 App 改期，NFZ 診所也希望來電取消以免浪費名額。

may_come_up.what: Zadatek lost on late odwołanie

sensitive_asked.what: Rejestracja asks PESEL to find the wizyta

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 公立 NFZ 看專科需轉診（skierowanie）且等候久；私立連鎖（Lux Med、Medicover）與牙醫多電話或 ZnanyLekarz 預約，必問 NFZ 或 prywatnie。

may_come_up.what: Rejestracja offers a teleporada (phone consult) instead
Prywatna wizyta price quoted when NFZ queue is months long

sensitive_asked.what: Asks PESEL to register the patient

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信、銀行、能源客服有語音選單並依 RODO 核身，第三人代打通常無法處理帳務。

may_come_up.what: Orange or bank infolinia refuses caller without pełnomocnictwo

sensitive_asked.what: Asks PESEL, card data or SMS codes

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 市政、戶政多走 ePUAP/mObywatel 線上或預約臨櫃；學校與幼兒園報名（rekrutacja）多為線上系統。

may_come_up.what: Urząd wizyta booked through an online e-kolejka

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 住家多為公寓，需告知街道、門牌、公寓號（m.）、樓層、對講機號碼（domofon）；水電與開鎖常以時段約。

may_come_up.what: Dojazd (callout) fee plus hourly rate
Blok without winda for heavy items

usually_asked: Street, building, m. number, floor and domofon

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 民宿（pensjonat、agroturystyka）與山區住宿常電話訂房並要求訂金（zadatek）；連鎖導向官網或 Booking.com。

may_come_up.what: Opłata miejscowa or klimatyczna per night
Zadatek transfer within 3 days to confirm

sensitive_asked.what: Asks card or dowód osobisty number

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 營業時間、刷卡、BLIK、庫存、可否帶狗等問題通常電話直接回答。

may_come_up.what: BLIK accepted alongside cards

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫（weterynarz）與寵物美容（groomer）可電話預約；出境需歐盟寵物護照與晶片。

may_come_up.what: Night or Sunday dyżur surcharge

sensitive_asked.what: Hotel dla psów asks transfer deposit

property.before_dialing_zh: 租屋多透過 Otodom、OLX 與房仲，看房多電話約；押金（kaucja）與 najem okazjonalny 規定要問清楚。

may_come_up.what: Agent asks the Otodom listing number

repair.before_dialing_zh: 汽車修理廠（warsztat）、春秋換胎（wymiana opon）與車檢（przegląd rejestracyjny）多可電話預約。

may_come_up.what: Paid diagnostyka komputerowa if repair declined
Wymiana opon fully booked in October

sensitive_asked.what: Asks VIN from the dowód rejestracyjny

usually_asked: Make, model, year and numer rejestracyjny

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 波蘭餐廳仍以電話、Facebook/Instagram 私訊訂位為主，大城市部分用 MojStolik；週末、情人節與 Wigilia 前公司聚餐（firmowa wigilia）要提早。

may_come_up.what: Stolik held about 15 minutes past the rezerwacja time
Zadatek for a firmowa wigilia or komunia party

sensitive_asked.what: Asks card number to guarantee a Kraków Rynek table

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 藥局（apteka）、麵包店與蛋糕店（cukiernia）可電話預留；週日多數商店不營業，復活節與聖誕蛋糕要提早訂。

may_come_up.what: Apteka orders a lek for next-day pickup

sensitive_asked.what: Cukiernia asks przedpłata for a tort

usually_asked: Pickup day before a non-trading Sunday

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 披薩、kebab 與中式外帶店常接電話自取；外送多走 Pyszne.pl、Glovo、Wolt、Uber Eats。

may_come_up.what: Dostawa only through Pyszne.pl or Wolt
BLIK, cash or card on odbiór

sensitive_asked.what: Asks card number by phone before cooking

tracking.before_dialing_zh: InPost 包裹櫃（Paczkomat）、Poczta Polska、DPD、DHL 追蹤多用網站或 App，客服有語音選單；建議改用 App 查詢。

may_come_up.what: InPost hotline points to the InPost Mobile app

sensitive_asked.what: Asks the Paczkomat kod odbioru from SMS

transport.before_dialing_zh: 計程車可電話叫車，但大城市以 Bolt、Uber、FREENOW、iTaxi 等 App 為主；機場接送可預約。

may_come_up.what: Dispatcher gives numer boczny (car number) and ETA
Fixed price to Chopin Airport

sensitive_asked.what: Car rental asks card or prawo jazdy number
